Identify the individual satisfying all constraints: An advocate for international peace, recognized with the same celebrated honor as a pioneering female figure from an earlier period. This individual authored analyses for a periodical publication that reported on developments within the military air arm of a major European republic, which was formally established in its capital following a major continental conflict. The reporting pertained to activities that contravened the terms of a specific post-conflict diplomatic instrument. This individual subsequently experienced confinement under an authoritarian regime of the same era, a circumstance linked to contracting a widespread and historically deadly respiratory illness. Finally, a public institution of higher learning, founded in the latter half of the twentieth century in a major urban center of a northern European nation, was officially renamed in honor of this individual during the final decade of that century. Provide the full name of this individual.
